description: End conditions. They match the referee, which ends a game automatically on each of them.

functions.name: is_check
functions.description: The side to move is in check.

functions.name: is_checkmate
functions.description: In check and no legal move.

functions.name: is_stalemate
functions.description: Not in check and no legal move.

functions.name: is_repetition
functions.description: The current position has occurred at least count times in the history, counting itself. Positions are equal if pieces, side to move, castling rights and en passant square (as in fen) are equal. count must be at least 1; is_repetition(3) is the threefold repetition.

functions.name: is_fifty_move_rule
functions.description: halfmove_clock is at least 100 and the position is not checkmate.

functions.name: has_insufficient_material
functions.description: That color cannot checkmate, used by the referee when the opponent runs out of time. True if the color has no pawns, rooks or queens and either only its king, or exactly one knight while the opponent has nothing but king and queens, or only bishops, all bishops on the board stand on squares of one color, and the opponent has no pawns and no knights.

functions.name: is_game_over
functions.description: is_checkmate or is_draw. Time, resignation and move limits are known only to the referee.
